metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves and spectral sensitivities from Polaroid Corporation, Polacolor 559 Film Data Sheet and its Technical Data for T-88, T-108, T-669, T-669S, T-559, T-559S, T-59 and T-809 Instant Color Peel-Apart Films (1999), vector plots: the print's blue, green and red densities at 70 F (21 C), taken as Status A, converted into dye amounts. A positive and the print at once, seen by reflection. Mid-grey where the three read the sheet's reference density, 0.75 (18% grey on a print), on average, on the sheet's relative axis; the pack carries the sheet's prints at 55 F and 95 F (13 and 35 C) too, its cold and hot processing. The spectral sensitivities continue past their plotted ends at their own final gradients and are balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. The sheet plots no dye spectra and no base: the dyes are those of 'fujifilm_crystal_archive_typeii', of agx's slides and colour papers the set that views the sheet's 70 F greys most neutral, and the base is the print's D-min in them (R 0.12, G 0.15, B 0.16). No spectral adaptation window and no DIR couplers. Exposure frame (type, densitometer, lights) from 'kodak_ektachrome_100'.
